text:
maya: Heads up — seeing a surge of ArgoCD/Flux sync failures in eu-west right after the LB change. Apps in app-of-apps are stuck in backoff and a few GPU pools are oscillating. Anyone else? @eng-infra-oncall :eyes:

liam: Yep, noticed ~150 sync failures starting ~1918001200. Argo logs showing a bunch of `rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing` and `503` responses.

sasha: deploy-bot flagged the spike. I restarted the argocd-repo-server to clear any repo cache but the underlying errors persist. Not a repo issue. :confused:

ryan: I pushed a terraform change earlier to tweak the NLB healthcheck from 10s -> 5s to speed up scale-in. TF apply completed at ~1918001100. Could be related.

liam: Kube nodes are flapping NotReady around the same time. `kubectl get nodes` shows multiple nodes with `NetworkUnavailable, NotReady`. Pods on GPU node groups got evicted then rescheduled, which is causing the app-of-apps fanout to retry and timeout.

maya: Log snippet from argocd-server: ```time="2026-03-18T11:07:23Z" level=error msg="sync failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection closed by remote host"```

sasha: AWS ELB health checks are reporting intermittent 502/504. CloudWatch shows Target Response Time spike correlating with our terraform change window.

ryan: Hmm — reducing healthcheck interval could make ASG decisions more aggressive. If nodes briefly fail healthcheck during kubelet restart, ASG might replace them, leading to churn.

liam: That churn explains the Argo backoff. ArgoCD opens many connections during app-of-apps reconciliation and if API server endpoints are constantly moving it triggers retries and then sync backoff.

maya: Proposed remediation: 1) revert NLB healthcheck back to 10s (terraform rollback), 2) temporarily increase ASG desired capacity for GPU pools to avoid immediate autoscaling during rollback, 3) scale argocd replicas to 3 and increase repo-server connection timeout, 4) monitor for node stabilization.

ryan: Rolling back the TF change now (plan looks clean). Will set healthcheck interval back to 10s and apply.

sasha: I'll hold on manual restarts. Once TF rollback done, let's wait 5-10 mins for targets to stabilize then reconcile Argo apps.

liam: Putting a temporary patch on argocd: `argocd-server --grpc-conn-timeout=30s` to give slow endpoints more time. Watch for memory pressure though.

maya: Also adding a short-term workaround: pin critical GPU-serving apps to specific nodeSelector to reduce rescheduling across ASGs during this window.

deploy-bot: [1918001432] terraform apply started by ryan (plan ok) :rocket:

ryan: Terraform apply complete. Healthcheck interval reverted. ASG desired capacity bumped by +2 for gpu-pool-eu-west.

sasha: CloudWatch: Target healthy count returning to normal, 5xx rate dropping. Nodes going back to Ready. :thumbsup:

liam: Reconciled the app-of-apps now. Sync errors reduced from ~150 -> 2. Gradually clearing backoff.

maya: Nice work. After things settle, let's add a preflight check in our TF pipeline to simulate healthcheck changes (small-scale) and a CI gate that warns when NLB health changes coincide with ASG scale policies. We keep breaking the same pattern.

ryan: Agreed. I'll open a follow-up RFC for a safer LB healthchange rollout and automated canary for ASG impacts.

sasha: Filing post-incident notes in #incidents after we confirm stable for 30m.

maya: Thanks all — keeping this channel for updates. :pray:
